definition: A transformer variant that uses only the encoder stack, producing contextual representations of input text rather than generating new text.
details: Encoder-only models like BERT are typically used for understanding tasks such as classification, named entity recognition, and embedding generation rather than free-form text generation.
story: Picture an architect laying out a building where every room has to know which other rooms matter to it. The layout decides what the machine can even attempt, before it learns a single thing. It is the blueprint that makes everything else possible. It is the difference between a row of isolated cubicles and one big room where everyone can hear each other. That blueprint is Encoder-Only Model.
